*Source: [The City of 7 Seraphs](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/269801/The-City-of-7-Seraphs?affiliate_id=549120)*

Exposed to and infused with raw Chaos, your body is wracked by physical instability. Your body constantly shifts and changes form piecemeal unless you actively exert control, and even then it still occurs at a subtle and perpetual level, and over time you become unrecognizable as the same person.

**Effect:** You take a –2 penalty on all Charisma-based skill checks due to the unsettling nature of your ever-shifting features and a –1 penalty to Fortitude saves due to a slight frailty imparted on your form. Whenever you cast a Transmutation effect, increase the save DC by +2 and all such effects are cast at one caster level higher.

At 5th level, add alter self to your list of 3rd-level oracle spells known

At 10th level, add baleful polymorph to your list of 5thlevel oracle spells known

At 15th level you become immune to unwanted polymorph effects and offensive polymorph subschool effects are instead turned back on the original caster
